task.title: Create a Repository from Your Project
task.shortdesc: Put an existing project under version control by turning its folder into a Git repository.

step.cmd: Create the repository in one of these ways:

choices.choice: In the Project view, right-click a folder that is not yet a repository and select .

info.note: If Ask user to create new repository is enabled, the Git Client also offers to create one when you open a project folder that is not under version control.

result.p: The folder becomes a local Git repository and the current working copy. It has no remote yet, so the Git Client prompts you for a remote URL the first time you push or pull.
